package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class C19 extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  private Clock.Ticket b;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), x, null); b = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(9), y, null); }
  public void stopped() throws Exception { super.stopped(); safeCancel(a); safeCancel(b); }
  private static void safeCancel(Clock.Ticket ticket)
  {
    if (ticket != null) ticket.cancel();
  }
}
